<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_data_broker_transform"><sys_ux_data_broker_transform action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><acl_failure_result/><api_name>x_1324635_grc_ops.getEmployee</api_name><batch_exclude>false</batch_exclude><description/><mutates_server_data>false</mutates_server_data><name>getEmployee</name><output_schema/><private>false</private><props>[
{
  "name": "userID",
  "label": "UserID"
}
]</props><required_translations/><schema_version>1.0.0</schema_version><script><![CDATA[function transform(input) {
    var loginUser = input.userID;
    var employees = [];

    var user = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
    user.addEncodedQuery("active=true^roles=x_1324635_grc_ops.grc_interns^u_coach=" + loginUser + "^ORu_dev_leader=" + loginUser);
    user.query();
    while (user.next()) {
        employees.push({
            "id": user.sys_id.toString(),
            "label": user.name.getDisplayValue()
        });
    }

    return employees;
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_ux_data_broker_transform</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>rkundu</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-24 11:25:23</sys_created_on><sys_id>bad4384b832a3a1002d6c3b6feaad336</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>getEmployee</sys_name><sys_package display_value="GRC: Operations Application" source="x_1324635_grc_ops">0890e72d834ae21002d6c3b6feaad302</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="GRC: Operations Application">0890e72d834ae21002d6c3b6feaad302</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_data_broker_transform_bad4384b832a3a1002d6c3b6feaad336</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>rkundu</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-24 11:39:31</sys_updated_on></sys_ux_data_broker_transform><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=bad4384b832a3a1002d6c3b6feaad336"/></record_update>
